content: {"rule":{"text":"Write every headline as a short phrase of a few words, never a full sentence.","scope":"scriptwriter","why":"The reviewer wants headlines kept to short phrases rather than sentence-length statements."}}

{"rule":{"text":"Keep each board to the few elements needed to follow the one tracked subject.","scope":"generator","why":"The reviewer loses the through-line when a board shows many elements at once; boards should stay sparse around the subject being followed."}}

{"rule":{"text":"Vary the opening device across videos; do not always start on an incident.","scope":"director","why":"The reviewer wants openings to vary from video to video instead of defaulting to an incident hook each time."}}

{"rule":{"text":"Verify every date, number and name against the source notes before writing it.","scope":"scriptwriter","why":"A factual detail that disagreed with the source slipped into the words; the reviewer wants facts checked against sources, not recalled."}}

{"rule":{"text":"Do not flag contractions in narration as informal; treat the conversational voice as intended.","scope":"curator","why":"The note shows the reviewer treats conversational contractions as a deliberate house voice, so flagging them as a tone defect is a recurring false positive."}}
